# vastdata_nic_port_related_ports (Data Source)

Datasource for retrieving related NIC port IDs

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vastdata_nic_port_related_ports" "primary_related" {
  nic_port_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nic_port_id` (Number) ID of the NIC port to get related ports for

### Read-Only

- `related_nic_port_ids` (List of Number) List of IDs of NIC ports that are logically the same physical port
